title: EduLink
heading: Settings
subtitle: Profile and security come from the server; preferences and institution identity are stored on this device.

profile.title: Profile
profile.desc: The account details shown across the platform.
profile.name: Name
profile.emailHint: Sign-in email — administration changes it on the users page once the backend is wired.
profile.emailInvalid: The email format is not valid.
profile.localNote: Saving is local at this stage — nothing is sent to the backend.
profile.readOnly: Your account details are read from the server and managed by your institution.
profile.readOnlyStaff: Name and email come from the server; edit them in Account management.

security.passwordDesc: Choose a strong password of at least 8 characters.
security.weakPassword: The password does not meet all the rules.
security.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.
security.devicesDesc: Signing in from several devices is allowed on the platform.
security.saveFailed: Could not save on the server.
security.serverNote: The password is written to your institution database. Sessions on other devices are not ended automatically.
security.adminManaged: Your password is managed by your institution — contact them to reset it.
security.sessionDesc: The server does not list other devices yet; this button ends your session on the device you are using now.
security.sessionNoList: Remaining sessions are handled server-side (Edu_Tokens table).

preferences.languageDesc: Arabic and English from day one, with the page direction switching too.
preferences.themeDesc: Light, dark, or follow the system preference.
preferences.notificationsDesc: What reaches you inside the platform.

notificationsHint.sessionReminders: Alert 15 minutes before each session starts.
notificationsHint.newMessages: Notify when a teacher, student or parent sends a message.
notificationsHint.weeklyReport: Weekly summary of teacher hours and attendance.

preferences.autoSavedNote: Choices are saved automatically on this device.

brand.title: Institution identity
brand.desc: Each institution gets its own build, domain and database — this is where the visible identity is set.
brand.supportEmailHint: Shown in alert messages and the help page.
brand.emailInvalid: The support email format is not valid.
brand.previewDesc: This is how the identity looks in the platform.
brand.previewNote: Preview only — the accent is not applied to the global theme until the backend is wired.
